cards.title: Operational Equivalence of fAUC/MIC and fCss/MIC for Continuous Infusion
cards.claim: For constant continuous IV infusion at steady state, fAUC_tau/MIC = tau × fCss/MIC for an explicitly stated time window tau. The source clearance equations share the same algebraic structure after replacing dose with infusion rate, but fAUC/MIC and fCss/MIC are not numerically or dimensionally identical. The binding-variability bias argument can be studied in both settings.
conditions: Low extraction ratio drugs where free clearance is independent of fu.
limitations: Specific to continuous infusion; intermittent dosing requires time-dependent integration.
Assumes linear binding kinetics for the simplification to hold.
cards.downstream_use: Simplifies PK/PD analysis for beta-lactams and other continuous-infusion antimicrobials by recognizing the shared algebraic structure of the clearance equations, while maintaining the distinction between AUC/MIC and Css/MIC quantities.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
